question: 数据中有多少家药店？
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM pois WHERE subtype = 'pharmacy'

question: 南京站地铁站 800 米内有多少家酒店？
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM pois p JOIN metro_stations m ON m.name = '南京站' WHERE p.subtype = 'hotel' AND ST_DWithin(p.geom::geography, m.geom::geography, 800)

radius_check.sql: SELECT ST_Distance(p.geom::geography, m.geom::geography) AS d FROM pois p JOIN metro_stations m ON m.name = '南京站' WHERE p.subtype = 'hotel'

question: 离总统府最近的地铁站是哪个？距离多少米？
gold_sql: SELECT m.name, ST_Distance(m.geom::geography, p.geom::geography) AS dist_m FROM metro_stations m JOIN pois p ON p.name = '总统府' ORDER BY dist_m LIMIT 1

topk_check.sql: SELECT ST_Distance(m.geom::geography, p.geom::geography) AS d FROM metro_stations m JOIN pois p ON p.name = '总统府' ORDER BY d LIMIT 2

question: 栖霞区有多少家银行？
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM pois p JOIN districts d ON d.name = '栖霞区' AND ST_Within(p.geom, d.geom) WHERE p.subtype = 'bank'

question: 鼓楼区内，500 米内有地铁站的医院有几家？
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM pois h JOIN districts d ON d.name = '鼓楼区' AND ST_Within(h.geom, d.geom) WHERE h.subtype = 'hospital' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM metro_stations m WHERE ST_DWithin(h.geom::geography, m.geom::geography, 500))

radius_check.sql: SELECT min(ST_Distance(h.geom::geography, m.geom::geography)) AS d FROM pois h JOIN districts d ON d.name = '鼓楼区' AND ST_Within(h.geom, d.geom) CROSS JOIN metro_stations m WHERE h.subtype = 'hospital' GROUP BY h.id

question: 玄武区面积是多少平方公里？
gold_sql: SELECT ST_Area(geom::geography) / 1e6 AS km2 FROM districts WHERE name = '玄武区'

question: 新街口商圈的日均客流量是多少？
南京各区去年的 GDP 是多少？
德基广场 900 米内有哪些地铁站？返回站名。
gold_sql: SELECT m.name FROM metro_stations m JOIN pois p ON p.name = '德基广场' WHERE ST_DWithin(m.geom::geography, p.geom::geography, 900)

radius_check.sql: SELECT ST_Distance(m.geom::geography, p.geom::geography) AS d FROM metro_stations m JOIN pois p ON p.name = '德基广场'

question: 外秦淮河在数据中的总长度是多少公里？
gold_sql: SELECT sum(ST_Length(geom::geography)) / 1000 AS km FROM waterways WHERE name = '外秦淮河'
